answer: What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. The ledge holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
